features.name: Balmerino Parish Church
features.shortDescription: The active parish church opened in 1811; interior access is tied to advertised services or arrangement rather than guaranteed tourist opening.
features.fullDescription: Opened 17/11/1811 (ic. 17 Nov. 1811). Small broad-eaved rubble-built rectangle, rubble built with gothick spired bellcote at W. gable. Originally with horeshoe gallery and pulpit on S. wall. S. wall originally 2 large windows flanked by 2 doors with windows over, now 4 window. Remodelled C. & L. Ower 1883-4, W. gallery instead of horseshoe, w. window and W. door, E. gable remodelled and stuccoed, 4 windows inserted in N. wall to match S. Original work has droved dressings, later work stugged dressings. Hall C. & L. Ower 1887. Re-roofed and re-ceiled 1959.

features.name: Manse, Balmerino Parish Church
features.fullDescription: 1816. 2-storey and attic, 3-window front of coursed whinstone with droved dressings, semi-octagonal porch probably later; 2 original piended dormers; flanks and rear rubble built. Original woodwork.
